strings.desc_atlas: Interactive 3D human body explorer with rotation, zoom, and layer controls.
strings.desc_systems: The 10 core anatomical systems stored locally in the offline IndexedDB database.
strings.desc_anatomy_lab: Isolation, layer visibility, and exploded view dissection tools.
strings.desc_physiology_lab: Interactive simulations for cardiovascular, respiratory, digestive, and musculoskeletal physiology.
strings.desc_imaging_lab: Local CT and MRI slice viewer supporting Axial, Coronal, and Sagittal planes.
strings.desc_academy: Bilingual educational library for systems, organs, and medical terminology.
strings.desc_quiz: Interactive quiz engine with MCQ, 3D identification, and local progress tracking.
strings.desc_settings: Manage app language, mobile performance profile, and open-source licenses.
strings.module_honesty_note: This section shell is established. Its interactive engine and verified medical content will be activated in its dedicated phase without dummy data.
strings.setting_language_desc: Switch interface language and apply RTL/LTR layout immediately.
strings.setting_quality_desc: Balances visual quality and memory usage for mid-range phones.
strings.setting_licenses_desc: Verified sources and licenses of all free libraries and assets used.
strings.atlas_prototype_disclaimer: Notice: The built-in 3D figure is a 6-layer prototype for testing dissection tools, NOT a medically accurate anatomical model.
strings.atlas_import_desc: Supports standard & Draco-compressed GLB files with full selection, isolation, and explode tools.
strings.phys_exp_cardio: Educational simulation: Higher heart rate increases cardiac output and pulse wave frequency to meet oxygen demand.
strings.phys_exp_resp: Educational simulation: Respiratory rate and tidal volume rise during exertion to support gas exchange.
strings.phys_exp_digest: Educational simulation: Peristalsis propels and mixes chyme, typically down-regulated during intense exertion.
strings.phys_exp_musc: Educational simulation: Higher load increases generated force while accelerating muscular fatigue.
